+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in Windows stderr, preserving other bytes."""
+    header = b"#< CLIXML\r\n"
+    closing = b"</Objs>"
+    result = bytearray()
+    offset = 0
+    search_from = 0
+    replaced = False
+
+    while (start := stderr.find(header, search_from)) != -1:
+        xml_start = start + len(header)
+        # A header is only a block when it is followed by an Objs document.
+        if not stderr[xml_start:].lstrip().startswith(b"<Objs "):
+            search_from = xml_start
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(closing, xml_start)
+        if end == -1:
+            break
+        end += len(closing)
+        block = stderr[start:end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                decoded = block.decode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                decoded = block.decode("cp437")
+            replacement = _parse_clixml(decoded.encode("utf-8"))
+        except (ET.ParseError, ValueError, UnicodeError):
+            search_from = xml_start
+            continue
+
+        result.extend(stderr[offset:start])
+        result.extend(replacement)
+        offset = end
+        search_from = end
+        replaced = True
+
+    result.extend(stderr[offset:])
+    return bytes(result) if replaced else stderr
